errors.text_span: достига локален връх малко над 70% през 2011 г.

The description for the 'Д Банк' (light grey) line claims it drops to 50% in 2016. However, the chart shows this line trending upwards after 2012, and it is around 75% in 2016, never dropping to 50% after its initial dip in 2009.
